title: VIP Tracker
note: A search of this repo found no screen, file or import named VIP Tracker. If the tracker lives in another system, agree the points below before connecting it. No VIP rows are shown, because none have been supplied.
consider: Analysis. Which VIP events should change a lead or a partner score, and which are only a watch note.
Data. The person or company, the region, the last contact, the next action, and the system the row came from.
Integration. A read-only pull on a schedule. Do not write back into the other system until the fields are agreed.
Possible pipeline. A scheduled job reads an export or an API, checks the columns, and writes a dated JSON file. This dashboard would read only that file.
Stale data. If the job stops, the last file would stay on screen. Each row needs a last-updated time, and the screen should say the feed is stale once that time is older than the agreed window.
